highValueFindings.finding: The app has a much wider BattleHistoryEntry schema than the current sample reports show.
highValueFindings.impact: TBI should accept optional fields without failing and report unknown/new fields in Debug.

highValueFindings.finding: The app separates Enemies Hit By, Enemies Destroyed By, and Killed With Effect Active.
highValueFindings.impact: TBI should not treat hits, kill source, and effect-window kills as the same thing.

highValueFindings.finding: Other is present as DestroyedByOther and Other Coin Bonuses is a separate currency field.
highValueFindings.impact: TBI should split Other Kills from Other Coin Bonuses.

highValueFindings.finding: Battle history stores IsTournament and DissonanceType internally.
highValueFindings.impact: TBI can add report tags for tournament/dissonance instead of relying on pasted marker text.

highValueFindings.finding: Newer enemy subtype totals exist: Saboteurs, Commanders, Overcharges.
highValueFindings.impact: TBI parser/enemy catalogue should support these now, even if older reports do not include them.

highValueFindings.finding: Guardian report fields exist for damage, summons, stolen/fetched coins, catches, gems, medals, shards, and module drops.
highValueFindings.impact: Systems/Command Deck can later evaluate Guardian value and loot contribution.
